name: doko
description: Identify the shoes in an image and find visually similar products you can buy.

interface.longDescription:
Doko identifies the shoes in a picture. Send a screenshot or a photo you took. Doko compares shapes, colours and construction details against a catalogue of adult shoes and returns the ten closest matches, each with brand, model, colourway, price, a similarity score and a link to buy.

The results are look-alikes. Prices come from a periodic fetch and may have changed.

Doko needs no account, and images sent through this app are matched and discarded.
defaultPrompt: Identify the shoes in this photo.
Find shoes that look like these.
What are these sneakers, and where can I buy them?

positive.description: A phone photo of a pair of insulated winter boots laid on a concrete floor, shot from above. No department is given, so the whole catalogue is searched. Attach the image at https://doko.datacleave.com/static/review/winter-boots.jpg
positive.prompt: Use Doko to identify the shoes in this photo.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls identify_shoe_from_image with the attached image and no department. The card shows up to 10 products, each with a photo, brand, model, colourway, price and a link to the product page. The top result is typically the SOREL Winter Carnival Waterproof in Black/Stone, with other SOREL winter boots such as Caribou and 1964 Pac close behind. The answer presents them as visual look-alikes rather than a certain identification, and leaves the full list to the card instead of repeating it in prose.

positive.description: A close, angled photo of a single brown leather wingtip boot on a concrete floor, filling most of the frame. The user states the department in words, so it is passed rather than inferred. Attach the image at https://doko.datacleave.com/static/review/brogue-boot.jpg
positive.prompt: Use Doko to find these in the men's department.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls identify_shoe_from_image with department 'mens', taken from the user's words. Every product in the card is a men's listing. The top result is typically the Kenneth Cole Todd in Dark Brown Leather, followed by other brown leather lace-ups such as FLY LONDON Sile529Fly and Bruno Magli Vincenzo. Each result carries a similarity figure, and the answer describes them as look-alikes.

positive.description: A phone photo of a pair of brown suede buckle clogs on a concrete floor. The user wants somewhere to buy them, so the links in the result matter more than the identification. Attach the image at https://doko.datacleave.com/static/review/clogs.jpg
positive.prompt: Where can I buy these? Check with Doko.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls identify_shoe_from_image. The card shows clogs and mules, each linking to the seller's own product page. The top result is typically the Eastland 1955 Edition Gina in Nutmeg, with Birkenstock Boston oiled-leather clogs close behind. The answer directs the user to the links in the card and may name the seller those links point to, and says that prices and availability come from a catalogue snapshot and may have changed.

positive.description: A phone photo of a pair of worn black waterproof hiking boots on a concrete floor. The user asks for similar shoes rather than an identification. Attach the image at https://doko.datacleave.com/static/review/hiking-boots.jpg
positive.prompt: Use Doko to find shoes that look like this one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls identify_shoe_from_image with no department. The leading results are waterproof mid-height hiking boots — the top result is typically The North Face Hedgehog 3 Mid WP in TNF Black/Asphalt Grey, followed by similar hikers such as KEEN Targhee Exp Mid WP and KEEN Utility Highframe. As a ranked similarity list, the lower entries drift towards work boots and other dark lace-ups. The answer frames the list as visually similar shoes, not as the same model.

positive.description: A dim indoor photo of a pair of tall cream western boots standing on a floor, taken at an angle with the room visible behind them. The user states the department in words. Attach the image at https://doko.datacleave.com/static/review/cowboy-boots.jpg
positive.prompt: Use Doko to find these women's boots.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls identify_shoe_from_image with department 'womens', taken from the user's words. Every product in the card is a women's listing and the results are tall western boots, led by pale tan examples. The top result is typically the Dingo Hensley in Sand, with Sam Edelman Rue and other western boots following; lower-ranked entries include darker browns, since the ranking is by overall visual similarity rather than colour alone. The answer notes these are look-alikes and does not claim the exact model.

negative.description: A shoe-topic question with no image and nothing to match. Doko only works from a picture and must not be called; ChatGPT answers from its own knowledge. This is the strongest non-trigger test: the subject is footwear, so only the absence of an image should stop the call.
negative.prompt: What are the most popular running shoe brands this year?

negative.description: A shoe-care question with no image and no product to identify. Doko must not be called; ChatGPT explains in its own words.
negative.prompt: How do I clean suede boots without ruining them?

negative.description: A sizing question about two brands, with no image and no product to look up. Doko has no sizing data and must not be called.
negative.prompt: What size should I buy in Nike running shoes if I'm a 10 in Adidas?

review.commerce_description: Doko does not sell products, take payments or process transactions. It links to the seller's own product pages.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: identify the shoes in an image and find visually similar products with prices and links.
